findings.label: Stale duplicate union in types/index.ts
findings.detail: types/index.ts carries its own AuditOperationType missing SESSION_NAME_CHANGED/SESSION_REOPENED, but the audit-logs.ts allowlist is typed against the union in audit-repository.ts (re-exported via audit-service.ts), with which it is now a complete in-order mirror. The duplicate is pre-existing and out of scope; worth collapsing to one source of truth later.
